sloka: परिवार्य प्रमुदिता भेजिरे विपुलाः शिलाः ।श्रोतुकामाः समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः ।। 5.57.48 ।।।।
transliteration: parivārya pramuditā bhejire vipulāḥ śilāḥ ।śrotukāmāḥ samudrasya laṅghanaṁ vānarottamāḥ ।। 5.57.48 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.
